Name: Mahath, Son of Amasai
Summary: Mahath, son of Amasai of the Kohathites, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: The Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites, to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Amasai, Father of Mahath; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Mahath stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
